errors.text: Replaces ink extrusion, hydrogen de-binding, and pressureless vacuum sintering with an unsupported high-pressure thermomechanical extrusion process.
Omits the required 1400°C for 18 h sintering schedule, titanium-sponge oxygen getter, and water quench from 1500°C.
Treats approximately 1 wt.% oxygen solely as contamination to suppress, whereas the target uses controlled oxygen as an interstitial-strengthening contribution.
Attributes phase control to strain rate and grain refinement rather than sequential hydride decomposition and quench-controlled retention of metastable beta-BCC.
Provides no mechanism or intervention for the target's silicide coating and approximately 700-fold oxidation-rate reduction.
The proposed ultra-high-vacuum limit of less than 10^-6 Pa is inconsistent with the target condition of less than 3×10^-6 torr and is not supported by the cited evidence.
